data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word anthos, meaning 'flower'. In ancient Greece, Anthia was a goddess of flowers and fertility. In Christian contexts, the name Anthia is associated with the virtues of grace, beauty, and growth. The name Anthia carries the meaning “Graceful, Flowering” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Anthia usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, flowering and live with faith, good character and purpose.
